headline_marked: Friends and well-wishers [[remember Toufique Imrose Khalidi]] at memorial service
headline: Friends and well-wishers remember Toufique Imrose Khalidi at memorial service
summary: The late editor-in-chief of bdnews24.com was honored for his bravery, objectivity, and unwavering commitment to professional journalism.
details: Friends, family, and well-wishers gathered at Dhaka’s Gulshan Club on Friday to memorialize the work and life of Toufique Imrose Khalidi, the late editor-in-chief of bdnews24.com.

Speakers at the event, including former caretaker government advisor Rasheda K Choudhury and cultural figure Ramendu Majumdar, praised Khalidi's intellectual depth and his steadfast adherence to journalistic ethics.
Ramendu Majumdar highlighted that Khalidi instituted objectivity in journalism and ensured bdnews24.com remained a source of credible news, refusing to bow to pressure.
Rasheda K Choudhury described him as a pioneer of digital journalism who weathered various storms while remaining independent and professional.
Attendees also recalled his personal warmth and his ability to bring people of all faiths and opinions together, specifically mentioning his Pahela Baishakh gatherings.
The memorial service included a minute of silence and prayers for the peace of his soul, with a brief biography read by Shahadat Hossain.
caption:
A pioneer of digital journalism and a symbol of objectivity. Friends and well-wishers gather to honor the legacy of Toufique Imrose Khalidi.

Friends, family, and well-wishers gathered at Dhaka’s Gulshan Club on Friday to memorialize the work and life of Toufique Imrose Khalidi, the late editor-in-chief of bdnews24.com.

Speakers at the event, including former caretaker government advisor Rasheda K Choudhury and cultural figure Ramendu Majumdar, praised Khalidi's intellectual depth and his steadfast adherence to journalistic ethics.

Ramendu Majumdar highlighted that Khalidi instituted objectivity in journalism and ensured bdnews24.com remained a source of credible news, refusing to bow to pressure.

Rasheda K Choudhury described him as a pioneer of digital journalism who weathered various storms while remaining independent and professional.

Attendees also recalled his personal warmth and his ability to bring people of all faiths and opinions together, specifically mentioning his Pahela Baishakh gatherings.

The memorial service included a minute of silence and prayers for the peace of his soul, with a brief biography read by Shahadat Hossain.

headline_marked: Fire [[engulfs passenger bus]] in Dhaka's Baridhara
headline: Fire engulfs passenger bus in Dhaka's Baridhara
summary: A Boishakhi Paribahan bus was gutted by fire on Friday evening; no casualties have been reported.
details: A passenger bus of Boishakhi Paribahan was engulfed in flames in the J Block of Road No. 7, Baridhara, Dhaka, on Friday evening.
The fire broke out at 5:48 pm, prompting a quick response from the Fire Service and Civil Defence.
Two units from the Baridhara Fire Station arrived at the scene by 5:57 pm and successfully brought the fire under control.
Bhatara Police Station officials moved the vehicle from the spot to clear the traffic.
The driver and the helper of the bus have been taken to the police station for questioning to determine the cause of the fire.
caption:
A passenger bus was gutted by fire in Dhaka's Baridhara on Friday evening.

A passenger bus of Boishakhi Paribahan was engulfed in flames in the J Block of Road No. 7, Baridhara, Dhaka, on Friday evening.

The fire broke out at 5:48 pm, prompting a quick response from the Fire Service and Civil Defence.

Two units from the Baridhara Fire Station arrived at the scene by 5:57 pm and successfully brought the fire under control.

Bhatara Police Station officials moved the vehicle from the spot to clear the traffic.

The driver and the helper of the bus have been taken to the police station for questioning to determine the cause of the fire.
